text.tspan: Page 8, chapter 1 continued
What the pen says, word for word, and what it means
THE VOICE IS MINE
“weird, not me [over: and now cannot give
up]”
'And now cannot give up' does not sound like Dinis.
SHOW THE BOOK, DO NOT LIST IT
“show storyboard here :)”
Put the storyboard panel with the ZX Spectrum here, in the
chapter.
TOPICS FIRST, DETAILS UNDER THEM
“NR → Not Relevant [over the XZ paragraph,
struck with a wave]”
The XZ paragraph is not relevant: cut it.
MEET THE READER WHERE THEY ARE
“REF [over: explorer coding]”
Explorer coding needs a reference.
MEET THE READER WHERE THEY ARE
“readers don't know about Wardley maps or
what I mean by "explorer"”
Explain explorer (and Wardley maps) before using the word.
THE VOICE IS MINE
“ZX FOUNDER? :) [after: You can be the
founder.]”
The name again: 'ZX founder', next to 'You can be the
founder'.
TOPICS FIRST, DETAILS UNDER THEM
“this is at the end [beside: limited company
in the UK, the case for Lithuania,
Portugal]”
The list of countries belongs at the end, with the company
chapters.
THE MAKING-OF OUT OF THE READER'S WAY
“move to end [beside: Two honest clauses
about that list]”
The two honest clauses move to the end.
THE MAKING-OF OUT OF THE READER'S WAY
“I don't think we should talk or mention too
much what was on the other book → this is
going to be a big rewrite ↳ maybe on that
section at the end about how this book was
written and evolved”
Less of the 2018 book: this is a big rewrite, and the 2018
story goes to the section at the end on how the book was
written and evolved.
